name: Metamagic Rod, Focused
body:
Aura strong (no school); CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.

Price varies by specific type:

Lesser focused metamagic rod 3,000 gp
Focused metamagic rod 11,000 gp
Greater focused metamagic rod 24,500 gp

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that are focused as though using the Focused Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Focused Spell

Cost varies by specific type:

Lesser focused metamagic rod 1,500 gp
Focused metamagic rod 5,500 gp
Greater focused metamagic rod 12,250 gp
